microtheory.name: motor_control
microtheory.definition: How nervous system generates + controls movement. Motor cortex, cerebellum, basal ganglia, spinal cord, muscle. Forward + inverse models, optimal control, motor learning, reaching, locomotion. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-execution pipeline.

concepts.name: motor_cortex
concepts.definition: Precentral gyrus. Somatotopic map of body. Sends commands to spinal cord + brainstem motor neurons. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-generation cortex.

concepts.name: primary_motor_cortex_m1
concepts.definition: M1. Direct connections to spinal motor neurons. Encodes movement parameters. Substrate analogue: substrate's primary action-output.

concepts.name: premotor_cortex
concepts.definition: Pre-M1. Action planning, movement preparation, sensory guidance. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-planning cortex.

concepts.name: supplementary_motor_area
concepts.definition: SMA. Sequence learning, complex actions, internally-generated movement. Substrate analogue: substrate's compositional action structure.

concepts.name: corticospinal_tract
concepts.definition: Direct pathway from M1 to spinal motor neurons. Substrate analogue: substrate's direct-action pathway.

concepts.name: alpha_motor_neuron
concepts.definition: Spinal cord neuron innervating muscle fibers. Final common path. Substrate analogue: substrate's action effector.

concepts.name: motor_unit
concepts.definition: Single alpha motor neuron + all muscle fibers it innervates. Substrate analogue: substrate's atomic action.

concepts.name: spinal_reflex
concepts.definition: Stereotyped response circuit at spinal level. Stretch reflex, withdrawal reflex. Substrate analogue: substrate's reflex-level response.

concepts.name: central_pattern_generator
concepts.definition: CPG. Spinal/brainstem circuit producing rhythmic movement (walking, breathing). Substrate analogue: substrate's autonomous-rhythm circuit.

concepts.name: muscle_synergy
concepts.definition: Coordinated muscle activation pattern. Building block of movement. d'Avella + Bizzi. Substrate analogue: substrate's composite-action pattern.

concepts.name: stretch_reflex
concepts.definition: Muscle stretching triggers contraction. Knee-jerk. Substrate analogue: substrate's automatic response.

concepts.name: forward_model_motor
concepts.definition: Predicts sensory consequence of motor command. Wolpert. Cerebellum. Substrate analogue: substrate's anticipation handler.

concepts.name: inverse_model_motor
concepts.definition: Computes motor command for desired outcome. Substrate analogue: substrate's goal-to-action mapping.

concepts.name: efference_copy
concepts.definition: Copy of motor command sent to perception, allowing distinction between self-caused + external sensation. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-action tagging.

concepts.name: corollary_discharge
concepts.definition: Internal feedback of motor command. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-monitoring signal.

concepts.name: optimal_control_motor
concepts.definition: Movement minimizes cost function (energy, jerk, end-point variance). Todorov + Jordan. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-minimization in action.

concepts.name: minimum_jerk_model
concepts.definition: Reaching minimizes integrated squared jerk. Flash + Hogan 1985. Substrate analogue: substrate's smooth-action principle.

concepts.name: minimum_variance_principle
concepts.definition: Harris + Wolpert. Movement minimizes end-point variance given signal-dependent noise. Substrate analogue: substrate's reliable-outcome action.

concepts.name: fitts_law
concepts.definition: Fitts 1954. Movement time = a + b log2(D/W + 1). Trade-off speed-accuracy. Substrate analogue: substrate's precision-speed trade-off.

concepts.name: motor_learning
concepts.definition: Skill acquisition. Cerebellum + basal ganglia + cortex roles. Substrate analogue: substrate's ActionSpec refinement.

concepts.name: internal_model_learning
concepts.definition: Acquiring forward/inverse models through practice. Substrate analogue: substrate's anticipation-handler training.

concepts.name: savings_motor
concepts.definition: Faster relearning after extinction. Implies preserved trace. Substrate analogue: substrate's residual-Mt persistence.

concepts.name: consolidation_motor
concepts.definition: Newly-learned skills stabilize over hours-days. Sleep enhances. Substrate analogue: substrate's offline-consolidation.

concepts.name: interference_motor
concepts.definition: Learning skill A then B can interfere with A. Distinct memory systems. Substrate analogue: substrate's conflicting-Mt interaction.

concepts.name: reaching_movement
concepts.definition: Hand-to-target. Bell-shaped velocity profile. Multi-joint coordination. Substrate analogue: substrate's directed-action pattern.

concepts.name: grasping
concepts.definition: Hand shape + force scaled to object. Anticipatory preshaping. Substrate analogue: substrate's object-adapted action.

concepts.name: locomotion
concepts.definition: Walking + running. CPGs + cortical modulation. Substrate analogue: substrate's continuous-action loops.

concepts.name: balance_postural_control
concepts.definition: Maintaining stable posture. Multi-sensory integration. Substrate analogue: substrate's homeostatic self-maintenance.

concepts.name: ataxia
concepts.definition: Loss of coordination from cerebellar damage. Substrate analogue: substrate's anticipation-failure pattern.

concepts.name: apraxia
concepts.definition: Loss of skilled action despite intact muscle + sensation. Cortical. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-Mt failure.

concepts.name: parkinsonism_motor
concepts.definition: Basal ganglia. Bradykinesia, rigidity, tremor. Action initiation impaired. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-selection failure.

concepts.name: embodied_motor_planning
concepts.definition: Movement plans grounded in body capabilities + environment. Not abstract. Substrate analogue: substrate's embodied-action grounding.

concepts.name: joint_action
concepts.definition: Coordinating with others. Joint attention + intention. Substrate analogue: substrate-substrate cooperation in action.

rules.name: forward_model_predicts_consequence
rules.head: the substrate sends an action command
rules.body: a forward model predicts the consequence in parallel. Mismatch drives learning. Wolpert. Substrate's anticipation pipeline.

rules.name: efference_copy_distinguishes_self_caused_sensation
rules.head: the substrate causes a sensory event by own action
rules.body: efference copy lets it know the sensation is self-caused. No surprise. Substrate's action-attribution.

rules.name: optimal_control_minimizes_cost
rules.head: the substrate produces movement
rules.body: the movement minimizes cost (energy, jerk, variance). Todorov + Jordan. Substrate's optimization in action.

rules.name: motor_learning_via_error_correction
rules.head: the substrate practices a skill
rules.body: discrepancies between predicted + actual outcomes drive internal-model refinement. Substrate's ActionSpec error-driven update.

rules.name: morphological_constraints_shape_movement
rules.head: the substrate has specific body structure
rules.body: available movements + their efficiency depend on morphology. Substrate's structure-constrained action.
